title: Fix missing kitty illustration, persistent “No” button on mobile, and floating teasing messages + classy background

requirements.text: Generate a new cartoon kitty illustration (with a love/heart symbol) based on the uploaded reference image (IMG_2195-2.jpeg), and use it as the primary kitty illustration on the proposal/home screen (replace the currently referenced /assets/generated/proposal-kitty.jpeg usage in the UI).

quotes: So regarding the Cartoon of Kitty, you make a Cartoon of Kitty based on the reference I gave. Don't insert any image. You make, you generate a Cartoon of Kitty like with the love symbol and put it over there.

acceptanceCriteria: The proposal/home screen displays the newly generated cartoon kitty illustration (not a broken image and not the prior placeholder).
The illustration is visually consistent with the uploaded reference (cartoon style) and includes a clear love/heart element.

requirements.text: Ensure all UI-referenced generated static assets used by the proposal/home screen exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and that the app does not reference missing filenames (including the primary kitty asset and any background/pattern assets).

quotes: Still, on the home screen, I don't see the carton of kitty. The photo is not there.
make sure you implement the app rightly

acceptanceCriteria: No broken image requests occur for /assets/generated/* on initial load of the proposal screen.
The primary kitty image loads successfully in both desktop and mobile viewports.

requirements.text: Fix the “No” button behavior so it persists at all times on all devices (especially mobile): it must never disappear/vanish due to positioning, container bounds, or input-mode differences (mouse vs touch). Maintain the evasive behavior while ensuring the button remains visible and interactable.

quotes: and on the no button in the mobile version, it's disappearing if you don't click on it. It should persist, right?
the note button can't be gone. It should persist.
make sure you implement the app rightly, the no button regarding

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the “No” button remains visible and clickable without requiring any prior click.
After every “No” click, the “No” button remains on-screen and repositions/evades without jumping off-screen or to an invalid location.
Evasive behavior works on desktop (mouse proximity) and has a sensible equivalent on touch devices (does not rely exclusively on window mousemove).

requirements.text: Update the teasing message popups so that each click on “No” spawns a random teasing message at a random position on the screen, and the message visibly “hovers/moves around” after appearing. Each “No” click must create a new popup (random message and random starting position) while keeping the “No” button present.

quotes: Like once they said no, once they click on no, you should get a random message, a teething message. And again, the no should be appearing immediately.
the random message has to pop up every time, means the random message has to hover all around the screen.
should each new message appear in a random floating position on the screen? Yes. Or should they animate move around after appearing? Yeah, they can move around after appearing

acceptanceCriteria: Each “No” click shows a teasing popup message at a random screen location (not anchored to the button).
The popup animates/moves after appearing (hovering/drifting effect) and then disappears after a short time.
Multiple “No” clicks in succession create multiple popups without breaking layout or blocking button interaction.

requirements.text: Improve the proposal/home screen background to be more classy and aesthetic while staying Valentine-themed; update styling so the background feels intentional and premium (e.g., refined gradients, subtle texture/pattern, and consistent contrast with the card/content).

quotes: And on the background, it should be like, it should be better. It has to be classy. It has to be aesthetic.

acceptanceCriteria: The background looks visually upgraded (more refined than a basic gradient) and does not reduce readability of the main prompt and buttons.
The updated background works in common mobile viewport sizes without banding/contrast issues.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all backend logic (if any) within the single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Do not add external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
Do not change the existing Yes/success flow semantics (it should still show the Yayyyy success screen with fireworks).

required: Cartoon kitty illustration based on the uploaded reference, with a love/heart symbol, clean background (proposal-kitty-cartoon.dim_768x768.png)
